name: Heliolune — Sun, Moon & Seasons
author: makehasteslowly
description: Sun, Moon & Seasons for the Omarchy bar: solar and lunar phases, sunrise/sunset with blue and golden hours, moonrise/moonset, a 24-hour sky path, 7-day moon forecast, and the Sun's yearly analemma with equinox and solstice countdowns. Drag the figure-8 to travel through the year. Offline astronomy validated against the US Naval Observatory; optional current weather. Three themes (Art Nouveau, Art Deco, Atomic) restyle the whole widget, light-theme aware.

barWidget.description: Sun & moon phases on the bar; popup with sky path, solar timetable, lunar forecast and the Sun's yearly figure-8.

schema.label: Sun on the Bar
schema.description: Show the Sun on the bar: the icon of its next event (blue hour, sunrise, golden hour, noon, sunset) and, with values, that event's time.

schema.label: Moon on the Bar
schema.description: Show the Moon on the bar: its phase disc and, with values, the illumination. Click it for the Moon view.

schema.label: Bar Details
schema.description: Icons only, or icons with values (the Sun's next event time, the Moon's illumination, the temperature).

schema.label: Celestial Colors
schema.description: Choose between Soft Celestial colors, Bold Vivid celestial colors, or the active Omarchy theme's colors.

options.label: Soft Celestial (Warm solar gold & lunar silver-blue)
Bold Vivid (High-saturation amber sun & electric cyan moon)

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Pick the style, which themes the whole widget. In chronological order: Art Nouveau (shaded moon in a beaded halo with vines; Mucha Botanical palette), Art Deco (banded moon with a stepped terminator; Emerald & Ruby palette), or Atomic (flat moon with orbiting electrons; Atomic Age palette of teal, atomic orange, mustard and cream).

options.label: Art Nouveau (Halo, vines and leaves, Mucha Botanical theme)
Art Deco (Streamline bands, stepped terminator, Emerald & Ruby theme)
Atomic (Orbits and starbursts, Atomic Age theme)

schema.label: Time Format
schema.description: Format sunrise, sunset, golden hour, and solar noon times in 12-hour, 24-hour, or system locale format.

schema.label: Current Weather
schema.description: Show the current temperature and sky condition next to the city. Fetched from Open-Meteo (api.open-meteo.com, no account or key) every 30 minutes using your rounded coordinates. Auto picks °F for US locales, °C elsewhere. Off makes no weather requests.

schema.label: Weather on the Bar
schema.description: Show the weather on the bar: a themed icon and, with values, the temperature. Needs Current Weather to be on. Click it for the forecast.

schema.label: Wind Speed Unit
schema.description: Unit for the wind speed in the weather details. Auto follows the temperature unit (mph with °F, km/h otherwise).

schema.label: Weather Refresh
schema.description: How often the current weather is fetched while weather is on.

schema.label: Weather Alerts
schema.description: When heavy rain, freezing rain, heavy snow, a thunderstorm or hail is happening or forecast within 12 hours, the alert scrolls across the bar every 20 seconds and shows at the top of the popup. Worked out from the same Open-Meteo forecast; no extra requests. Not an official warning service.

schema.label: Sky Card
schema.description: Show the 24-hour sky path card in the Sun view.

schema.label: Sun Card
schema.description: Show the Sun card (phase, day length and the day's timetable) in the Sun view.

schema.label: Moon Card
schema.description: Show the Moon card (altitude, moonrise and moonset, distance, next quarter, full and new Moon) in the Moon view's Today tab.

schema.label: Year Card
schema.description: Show the Sun's yearly path and the next equinox/solstice countdown in the Sun view.

schema.label: Week Numbering
schema.description: Week number shown beside the date. Auto uses US numbering when the locale starts weeks on Sunday, ISO 8601 otherwise.

schema.label: Seasons
schema.description: Astronomical seasons start at the equinoxes and solstices; meteorological seasons start on the first of March, June, September and December.

schema.label: Golden & Blue Hour
schema.description: Sun-altitude windows for golden and blue hour. Standard: golden from sunrise to 6°, blue -6° to -4°. Photographer: golden -4° to 6°. Extended: golden -4° to 10°, blue -8° to -4°.

schema.label: Observer Elevation
schema.description: Your height above sea level in metres (0-9000). Lowers the horizon so sunrise comes slightly earlier and sunset later. Leave at 0 for sea level.

schema.label: Manual Latitude Override
schema.description: Optional decimal latitude (-90 to 90, e.g. 38.72). Leave empty to automatically sync with Omarchy Weather or IP geolocation.

schema.label: Manual Longitude Override
schema.description: Optional decimal longitude (-180 to 180, e.g. -9.14). Leave empty to automatically sync with Omarchy Weather or IP geolocation.

schema.label: Custom Location Label
schema.description: Optional city/place name displayed when using manual coordinates.
